name: screentrackr
description: Ask your movie library real questions: what you own, what you've watched, your ratings, next to a local IMDb catalog.
long_description:
ScreenTrackr keeps your movie library (what you own, what you've watched, your ratings) next to a full movie catalog that it builds on your computer from IMDb's public datasets. Ask in plain words, for example "Which Villeneuve movies do I own that I haven't watched?" or "What highly rated thrillers under two hours should I rent?"

First run: ask Claude to set up the catalog. It downloads about 1 GB from datasets.imdbws.com once and takes several minutes. Everything stays on your computer in ~/.screentrackr, the same folder the screentrackr command line tool uses. No account, no API key, no telemetry.

Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. Not affiliated with IMDb or Apple.

tools.name: search_movies
tools.description: Search your library or the whole catalog by director, cast, genre, rating, runtime, year and status.

tools.name: get_movie
tools.description: One movie by library id or IMDb id, with every library edition of it.

tools.name: library_stats
tools.description: Counts for your library by status, genre, director and decade.

tools.name: watch_stats
tools.description: What you watched: plays and films by year, release decade, genre and director, and your ratings.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: Your own lists of movies, with their counts.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create one of your own lists.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete one of your lists, never the movies in it.

tools.name: list_add
tools.description: Add library movies to one of your lists by id or IMDb id.

tools.name: list_remove
tools.description: Take library movies out of one of your lists.

tools.name: update_movie
tools.description: Set status, watched era or date, or your rating on one library item.

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Add a catalog movie to your library.

tools.name: log_viewing
tools.description: Record a play of one library movie (default today).

tools.name: list_viewings
tools.description: Your plays, newest first, for one movie or the whole library.

tools.name: remove_viewing
tools.description: Delete one play by its viewing id.

tools.name: setup_catalog
tools.description: Download the IMDb datasets and build the local catalog in the background.

tools.name: catalog_status
tools.description: Whether the catalog is built, and the progress of a running setup.

tools.name: pick_movie
tools.description: Pick a movie to watch at random, within the search filters.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: A JustWatch search link for one movie. Only a link; nothing is fetched.
